name: offlinepdf-mcp
description: Local Model Context Protocol server exposing OfflinePDF's PDF tools (merge, split, OCR, extract text, repair, POS receipts, and more) as functions Claude can call directly on your machine. Nothing leaves your device.

scripts.test: npx tsx test/mcp.check.ts && npx tsx test/electron-env.check.ts
scripts.mcpb:pack: npm run build && npm run stage && mcpb pack .mcpb-stage offlinepdf-mcp-0.1.0.mcpb
